name: Fly.io
notes: No perpetual free tier for new customers — Fly.io is pure pay-as-you-go and states "Fly.io no longer offers plans to new customers." The legacy free allowances (3x shared-cpu-1x 256MB VMs, 3GB volume storage, 100GB NA/EU outbound) are honored only for organizations that were on the deprecated Hobby/Launch/Scale plans. New signups get a time-limited free trial only: 2 total VM hours OR 7 days of access (whichever comes first), up to 10 machines (max 2 vCPU / 4GB RAM each), 20GB volume storage; trial machines auto-stop after 5 minutes of runtime. No credit card needed to start the trial, but adding a card ends the trial and converts to paid; after trial, apps stop until billing is set up. Ongoing use requires a credit card on file.
